title: Penthouse February 1994 Complete w/ Centerfold Joel the Ripper Brute Camps
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and glossy with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, February 1994, original $4.95 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Cover features: Xaviera: How Much Love Your Lady Really Needs; 17 Dead Girls: "Joel the Ripper's" Gruesome Confessions; Brute Camps: $200 Million Prison Scam; Getting Physical: Workout Gear for Fashion Fitness.

Back cover: Absolut Hofmekler vodka ad (homage to Edouard Manet).

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
